column1: # Words ending in 子 (mostly neutral 子 suffix); includes curriculum rows plus any
# Columns: hanzi, pinyin, english, jun_da_rank, frequency, frequency_in_wordlist,
# jun_da_rank = 序列号 and frequency = 频率 from assets/CharFreq-Modern-JunDa.tsv for the
#   first character of hanzi (Jun Da is single-character; 子-suffix words share a common tail).
# frequency_in_wordlist = number of rows in assets/wordlist.tsv whose hanzi column equals this lemma (exact string).
# first_char_ids_leaf_count: number of IDS leaf glyphs for the first character of hanzi, from
#   assets/dictionary.txt (merged with dictionary.Txt) decomposition — same leaf walk as
# first_char_leaves_in_curriculum: how many of those leaves appear as a character in
#   or as a glyph form parsed from radicals_01.tsv / radicals_02.tsv (radical_forms + simplified_or_note),
# Pinyin spacing follows assets/wordlist.tsv (syllables separated by spaces).
# Note: Game vocabulary puzzles load from assets/wordlist.tsv (dictionary_entries JSON).
# This file is a curriculum / allowlist slice; wire it in code or merge rows into wordlist when needed.
# Data rows: sorted by first-character IDS leaf curriculum coverage (desc): leaves_in_curriculum
#   / ids_leaf_count; full coverage (hits == total > 0) first. Ties: more curriculum hits, more
#   total leaves, higher frequency_in_wordlist, then lower jun_da_rank (more common first char).
